businesses.business: Biometric identity verification and airport access

offering_description.value: Clear Secure sells memberships that let air travelers verify their identity biometrically and use dedicated lanes at participating airport security checkpoints. It also provides TSA PreCheck enrollment and airport queue reservations, and offers identity verification software that organizations integrate into their own services.

primary_services.value: Expedited airport identity checks; TSA PreCheck enrollment; airport security queue reservations

customer_segment.value: B2C: Air travelers, especially frequent flyers, and TSA PreCheck applicants; B2B: Airlines, private airport operators, healthcare organizations, online platforms and event venue operators; B2G: Public airport authorities using checkpoint or queue management services

end_markets.value: Air travel; healthcare; online professional networking; live events

revenue_model.value: subscription: Annual memberships for expedited airport identity checks; service fees: TSA PreCheck application enrollment and renewal; project or contract: Enterprise identity verification and airport queue management agreements
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses identity documents and biometrics to verify travelers and enroll eligible applicants in TSA PreCheck; software / platform: Processes identity evidence for businesses verifying users and manages checkpoint reservations for airports

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with airport reservation services at select Canadian and European airports

specialization.value: related lines: Airport identity checks, trusted traveler enrollment, queue reservations and enterprise identity verification

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated airport enrollment kiosks and checkpoint stations; online: Company website and mobile app for membership and travel services; partners / resellers: Airline loyalty programs, credit card benefits and airport websites; direct sales: Enterprise sales to airports, healthcare organizations and online platforms
distribution_channels.category: own locations; online; partners / resellers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: TSA authorization for PreCheck enrollment, airport checkpoint requirements and biometric privacy laws

notes: The current list of international airport deployments and the fee structure for enterprise contracts are uncertain.
